dct_title_s: Haley Quadrangle, Minnesota-St. Louis County, 1964: 7.5 Minute Series (Topographic) Map
dct_description_sm: Haley quadrangle topographic map (N4752.5-W9237.5/7.5) featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in pencil and red ink regarding logging railroad lines and camps in the area west of Lake Vermillion. The hand written notations include information on the following logging camps noted with 'C'.
